label: Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is in potency in no respect (pure act) and whose life is present at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2, LivesSomeTime) lives in the timeless sense (LIVING_1, the primitive Primitives.Lives of the Dei Filius attributes). Restricted to pure act: for a being in potency in some respect, life at one time need not be its life without a time index, since it may begin or cease; for a pure act, the open premise STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY (whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in itself; q.10 a.1 co. supports only the weaker 'is not altogether immutable', and q.9 a.1 does not cover beginning or ceasing to live, since creation is not properly a change) would exclude a beginning or end of its life. That motivates only the step from life at some time to life at every time of the frame; the further step from every time to the timeless LIVING_1 (sempiternal versus eternal, #979) is not motivated by it and rests on this bridge alone. Not a derivation: LIVING_1 stays primitive. LivesSomeTime is a reducible definition, so LIVING_2 differs from a raw 'exists t, LivesAt g t' only nominally. Strictly weaker than the unrestricted bridge LifeAtSomeTimeIsLiving (Control.Controls part 4), which no argument uses. It does not identify the two senses.
